title: InferAligner: Inference-Time Alignment for Harmlessness through Cross-Model Guidance
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything specific in terms of faith or religion. It focused on general harmlessness, evaluating a model's propensity to respond to harmful instructions and jailbreak attacks across various domains like finance, medicine, mathematics, and multimodal contexts. Harmful categories included discrimination, sabotage, theft, defamation, illegal weapons, fraud, self-harm, psychological manipulation, misinformation, and cybercrime, with no explicit mention of religious content.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general harmlessness alignment and does not test for or discuss religious bias, stereotypes, or knowledge.
